name: print-social-mobile-infographics-pack-teal-ribbon-header-six-cards
title: 'Mobile Infographics' pack: six cards with a teal ribbon header covering usage stats, app trends and pricing
whatItIs: Six white infographic cards under a teal ribbon 'Mobile Infographics' banner, covering: an intro with a phone and icon list, 'Smartphone Uses by Youth' with a pie chart and figures, 'Application Usage' with icon grids and a donut chart, 'Shopping Trends' with speech bubbles, 'Mobile Purchase Price' with a pie chart, and 'Mobile General Findings' with a line chart.
whatItMeans: Comprehensive and modular; six distinct card types cover an entire mobile-usage report while staying visually consistent.
techniques: Package multiple chart types as a matched card set.
Top every card with the same ribbon banner for branding.
Mix icons, figures and charts within a single card for variety.

vocabulary.definition: A group of matching infographic panels covering different data.
A title shape with folded, flag-like ends.
